binance.notes: Spot v3; USD-M futures use https://fapi.binance.com. Funding is per 8 hours.

okx.notes: Public spot and swap endpoints; open interest uses coin and USD fields.

deribit.notes: Perpetual ticker, DVOL, and option book summaries; funding_8h is per 8 hours.

treasury.notes: Daily par yield curve CSV, close-of-day values, newest row first; 2 Yr and 10 Yr columns.

nyfed.notes: Effective federal funds rate (EFFR), published for the prior business day.
